items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I took Clarence on the banjo and I took August on bass.

ctx.x: Burnell, yeah. He had a whole lot of bad chords but he could finger like the devil. He played by head. Play the way he feel like playing. So they would try to play. I played in the band a little while with them but they had this kid that he'd make all the bad chords but he could run all over the piano. He needed to take lessons. He wouldn't do it. But for that head stuff he was a bad man when he played some of your audio. So now we play it. So I went out there with my band and I played. I had started taking my…
Eddie Summers? Yeah, Eddie. That's right. He lost a leg last year. Yeah.

items.title: Clarence Gabriel Interview
items.q: Manny was the old? Well, he is. He's about seven years old.

ctx.x: Is he much older than you?

Manny was the old? Well, he is. He's about seven years old. Seven years old. All right. You played with Kidronale a while too, didn't you? Oh, I did. I played with Kidronale. I played with, uh, Kid Brother for a while. Oh, yeah. With his band. And, uh, oh, there were so many bands. Yeah. Probably the beginning of the street. Uh-huh.
I was going to ask some more about Louis Dumaine band. Did you make any records with Louis Dumaine when he made those? Well, I did. He made some for Victor once.
